traditions.WLC: לִ כְנ֨וֹס בָּ הֶ֜ם לִ שְׂדֵ֤י הֶ עָרִים֙ מְנָא֣וֹת הַ תּוֹרָ֔ה לַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ לַ לְוִיִּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς συνηγμένοις ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄρχουσιν τῶν πόλεων , μερίδας τοῖς ἱερεῦσι καὶ τοῖς Λευείταις ,
traditions.VUL: ut introférrent per eos príncipes civitátis in decóre gratiárum actiónis , sacerdótes et Levítas :
traditions.KJV: to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites :

44.english_reference: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י שִׂמְחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל הַ כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ עַל הַ לְוִיִּ֖ם הָ עֹמְדִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εὐφροσύνη ἐν Ἰούδᾳ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς Λευείτας τοὺς ἑστῶτας .
traditions.VUL: quia lætificátus est Iuda in sacerdótibus et Levítis adstántibus .
traditions.KJV: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited .

45.english_reference: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God , and the ward of the purification ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּשְׁמְר֞וּ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת אֱלֹֽהֵי הֶם֙ וּ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַֽ טָּהֳרָ֔ה וְ הַ מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְ הַ שֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐφύλαξαν φυλακὰς θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ φυλακὰς τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ καὶ τοὺς ᾄδοντας καὶ τοὺς πυλωρούς ,
traditions.VUL: Et custodiérunt observatiónem Dei sui , et observatiónem expiatiónis , et cantóres , et ianitóres
traditions.KJV: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God , and the ward of the purification ,

45.english_reference: according to the commandment of David , [ and ] of Solomon his son .

traditions.WLC: כְּ מִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐντολαὶ Δαυεὶδ καὶ Σαλωμὼν υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: iuxta præcéptum David , et Salomónis fílii eius ,
traditions.KJV: according to the commandment of David , [ and ] of Solomon his son .

46.english_reference: For in the days of David and Asaph of old [ there were ] chief of the singers ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי בִ ימֵ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְ אָסָ֖ף מִ קֶּ֑דֶם ראש הַ מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν ἡμέραις Δαυεὶδ Ἀσὰφ ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς πρῶτος τῶν ᾀδόντων
traditions.VUL: quia in diébus David et Asaph ab exórdio erant príncipes constitúti cantórum
traditions.KJV: For in the days of David and Asaph of old [ there were ] chief of the singers ,

46.english_reference: and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God .

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁיר תְּהִלָּ֥ה וְ הֹד֖וֹת לֵֽ אלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὕμνον καὶ αἴνεσιν τῷ θεῷ .
traditions.VUL: in cármine laudántium , et confiténtium Deo .
traditions.KJV: and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God .

47.english_reference: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel , and in the days of Nehemiah , gave the portions of the singers and the porters , every day his portion :

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ בִּ ימֵ֨י זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וּ בִ ימֵ֣י נְחֶמְיָ֗ה נֹֽתְנִ֛ים מְנָי֛וֹת הַ מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וְ הַ שֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ יוֹמ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν ἡμέραις Ζοροβαβὲλ διδόντες μερίδας τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ τῶν πυλωρῶν , λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et omnis Israel , in diébus Zoróbabel , et in diébus Nehemíæ , dabant partes cantóribus et ianitóribus per dies síngulos ,
traditions.KJV: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel , and in the days of Nehemiah , gave the portions of the singers and the porters , every day his portion :

47.english_reference: and they sanctified [ holy things ] unto the Levites ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מַקְדִּשִׁים֙ לַ לְוִיִּ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἁγιάζοντες τοῖς Λευείταις ,
traditions.VUL: et sanctificábant Levítas ,
traditions.KJV: and they sanctified [ holy things ] unto the Levites ;

47.english_reference: and the Levites sanctified [ them ] unto the children of Aaron .

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֖ים לִ בְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἁγιάζοντες τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρών .
traditions.VUL: et Levítæ sanctificábant fílios Aaron .
traditions.KJV: and the Levites sanctified [ them ] unto the children of Aaron .
